# Goodbits

Goodbits is a service that helps you and your business create stellar newsletters from the best links your team and customers are reading.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/goodbits/.

## Actions

- **Create Link**: Create a content link in Goodbits Content Library.
- **Create Subscriber**: Add a new subscriber to the newsletter.
- **Delete Subscriber**: Mark a subscriber as deleted.
- **Get Newsletter Info** (read-only): Fetch newsletter identifier and name.
- **Update Subscriber Status**: Update subscriber status.
